rationale: The assistant reached the right conclusion (broken right-hand spring) and ultimately told the customer to get an engineer, which fits since the unit can't be pulled out. However, the route was weak: irrelevant questions about wiring, latch and alignment, and a latch check repeated after the customer had already said the door closes square and latches. The closing 'Note whether moving or pressing the door changes anything' ignores what the customer had already said. It never mentioned that springs are replaced in pairs, never isolated power/water before pulling the unit out, and never covered the partial model LTF 8B019 or told the engineer what to bring.
